intent_description: Retrieve or list catalog entities related to another entity or business concept. Use when the user asks which, what, show, find, or list related entities without requesting an explanation.
Retrieve source tables or source columns used by a catalog entity.
Explain the meaning, definition, purpose, or business context of a specific entity or business concept itself.
Explain related catalog entities or concepts when the user explicitly requests explanation, interpretation, or contextual discussion of those related entities.
Used when the user intent cannot be confidently classified.
